decision: A new automation job must run as the landing zone identity, against the ARM API, from a publicly pullable image.
why: A job needing its own identity, a data-plane path, or an authenticated base image cannot run unattended in every landing zone.
steps: Draft the job under landing-zones/automation/, using only ARM calls and no data-plane or VNet-dependent calls.
Draft a Dockerfile with a base image pullable without authentication.
Draft registration in landing-zones/bicep/modules/landingzone-automation.bicep, following the existing job pattern.
Present all proposed changes and wait for permission to implement.
Verify the job uses the landing zone identity without a separate identity or secret.
violations: Automation job authenticating with its own secret instead of the landing zone identity.
Job image hosted in a registry requiring authentication.
